people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

translations.web: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and brought accusation against the Jews.
translations.bsb: At this time some astrologers came forward and maliciously accused the Jews,
